quote_zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇350mL，开动搅拌，室温下将6.6g氢氧化钾(85％，0.1mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为97.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
arithmetic_check: Both printed charges close. Potassium hydroxide: 6.6 g of the 85 percent grade is 5.61 g of KOH; KOH is 56.11 g/mol, giving 0.1000 mol against the printed 0.1 mol, exact to the printed precision. Methyl ester: 34.8 g at 98 percent is 34.10 g; C10H10BrClO4S is 341.60 g/mol, giving 0.0998 mol against the printed 0.1 mol, low by about 0.2 percent, which is rounding of the purity-corrected charge and not a molar-mass error. The two charges are therefore equimolar as printed, one equivalent of base per ester, which the text does not state as a ratio. No product-side check is possible: the salt is never isolated, the step prints no product mass and no yield, and the only product figure is the in-process normalised liquid chromatography content of 97.3 percent. For reference and not printed anywhere in the patent, 0.1 mol of the potassium salt C9H7BrClKO4S at 365.67 g/mol would weigh 36.57 g, but the patent never weighs it. No mass_balance_implausible, no molar_mass_inconsistent, and no scale_discontinuity, this being the first step of the section. Neither the 85 percent grade being dripped in nor the absent product mass is treated as an arithmetic failure: a guard must not report a finding it could not check. Nothing was manufactured to meet the pass prompt's expectation of failing arithmetic, which describes the reference patent and not this one.

No drawing_text_conflict and no sodium versus potassium disagreement in this section. tert-Butanol is written but not drawn, the ordinary omission of a solvent from a scheme, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised. No attribution question arises: this is an experimental example, not an overview scheme, and no drawing in this patent is marked presented_as unclear.

quote_zh: 向反应釜中加入70mLDMF、12.6g三氟乙醇(99％，0.125mol)和26.1g氢氧化钾溶液(30％，0.14mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(97.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.4g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为96.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率89.3％。
arithmetic_check: Inputs close; the product side DOES NOT CLOSE and is flagged. Trifluoroethanol: 12.6 g at 99 percent is 12.47 g; C2H3F3O is 100.04 g/mol, giving 0.1247 mol against the printed 0.125 mol. Potassium hydroxide: 26.1 g of a 30 percent solution is 7.83 g of KOH, giving 0.1396 mol against the printed 0.14 mol, so the 26.1 g is the solution and the 0.14 mol is the KOH it contains, and the pair is consistent. The benzoate salt is charged as 0.1 mol at 97.3 percent with no mass printed, so it cannot be tested on its own; it is the limiting reagent, with the alcohol at 1.25 and the base at 1.4 equivalents on the printed moles. Product side: C11H10ClF3O5S is 346.70 g/mol, so 0.1 mol gives 34.67 g theoretical. The printed 32.4 g at the printed 96.0 percent HPLC content is 31.10 g of the acid, that is 0.08971 mol, which is 89.71 percent of theory on the printed 0.1 mol of methyl ester and 89.86 percent on the 0.0998 mol that charge actually contains. The printed two-step yield is 89.3 percent, on the same methyl ester basis the patent states, and neither figure reproduces it. The rounding of the printed numbers cannot absorb the gap: the lowest value the printed precision allows, 32.35 g at 95.95 percent content, still gives 89.51 percent. Recovering 89.3 percent from the printed mass and content requires a molecular weight near 348.3 g/mol, about 1.6 above the compound actually named and drawn, or a methyl ester basis near 0.1005 mol, which no printed number gives. The uncorrected mass gives 32.4 / 34.67 = 93.45 percent, further away. Nothing is chemically impossible, since 32.4 g gross is below the 34.67 g theoretical and the printed yield is the lower of the two figures; mass_balance_implausible is raised under rule 27 for the mass-versus-yield disagreement and every number is left exactly as printed. molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised, because no printed mass and mole pair for a named compound in this section implies a wrong molecular weight; the discrepancy is in the derived yield only. For A5: the same small negative bias, the printed yield sitting a few tenths of a point below what the printed mass and content give, recurs across the examples of this patent, so this looks like a systematic yield convention rather than a typographical error here, and it is the reason the flag is raised on a gap of only about 0.4 points. Also for A5, deliberately not flagged: step (1) can deliver at most 0.0998 mol while this step charges the whole unisolated batch as a nominal 0.1 mol, and step (1) prints no output mass at all, so the carry can be neither confirmed nor contradicted and scale_discontinuity is not raised.
